例句

  1. When I was studying in Paris, a famous painter bought me a meal at a first-class restaurant.
    我在巴黎念書的時候，一位有名的畫家請我在一家一流的餐廳吃了一頓飯。
  2. When I was walking home, it started to rain.
    我走路回家的時候，開始下雨了。
  3. While we were having dinner, the phone rang.
    我們吃晚餐的時候，電話響了。
  4. When I was living in Osaka, I met my wife.
    我住在大阪的時候，認識了我太太。
  5. I was taking a shower when the earthquake happened.
    地震發生的時候，我正在洗澡。
  6. While Ken was studying in Taipei, he learned to speak Chinese.
    Ken 在台北讀書的時候學會了說中文。
  7. When we were driving to Nagoya, our car broke down.
    我們開車去名古屋的時候，車子壞了。
  8. What were you doing when I called you?
    我打電話給你的時候，你在做什麼？
  9. My aunt bought me a pair of shoes.
    我阿姨買了一雙鞋給我。
  10. I bought a cake for my grandmother.
    我買了一個蛋糕給我奶奶。
  11. Grandma made us a cake.
    奶奶做了一個蛋糕給我們。
  12. Can you buy me a bottle of water?
    你可以買一瓶水給我嗎？
  13. Tom bought a present for his girlfriend.
    Tom 買了一份禮物給他女朋友。
  14. My mother cooked dinner for us.
    我媽媽煮晚餐給我們吃。
  15. I'll make you some coffee.
    我來幫你泡點咖啡。
  16. My uncle bought us lunch at a sushi restaurant.
    我叔叔在一家壽司店請我們吃午餐。
  17. We stayed at a first-class hotel.
    我們住在一家頂級飯店。
  18. I have a ten-year-old brother.
    我有一個十歲的弟弟。
  19. It was a two-hour movie.
    那是一部兩小時的電影。
  20. We took a three-day trip to Hokkaido.
    我們去了一趟三天的北海道旅行。
  21. She wrote a five-page report.
    她寫了一份五頁的報告。
  22. There is a ten-minute break between classes.
    課和課之間有十分鐘的休息時間。
  23. When I was traveling in Italy, an old man bought me a cup of coffee.
    我在義大利旅行的時候，一位老先生請我喝了一杯咖啡。
  24. While my sister was studying in London, she cooked Japanese food for her friends.
    我姊姊在倫敦讀書的時候，煮日本菜給她的朋友吃。
  25. My host family bought me a first-class train ticket.
    我的寄宿家庭買了一張頭等車廂的火車票給我。
  26. When my son was crying at the station, a kind woman bought him an ice cream.
    我兒子在車站哭的時候，一位好心的女士買了一個冰淇淋給他。
  27. I was reading a book when my friend came to see me.
    朋友來看我的時候，我正在看書。
  28. It was a first-class performance.
    那是一場一流的表演。
  29. Dad made me a sandwich for lunch.
    爸爸做了一個三明治給我當午餐。
  30. While I was waiting for the bus, I bought a newspaper for my father.
    我在等公車的時候，買了一份報紙給我爸爸。
  31. I made a birthday card for my mom.
    我做了一張生日卡片給我媽媽。
  32. Ann made a scarf for her boyfriend.
    Ann 做了一條圍巾給她男朋友。
  33. My father cooked us breakfast this morning.
    我爸爸今天早上煮早餐給我們吃。
  34. Sit down. I'll cook you some noodles.
    坐下吧。我煮點麵給你吃。
